canonical_consumer.coverage: 12 retraction fixtures; repeated reliability controls, not 12 independent scientific worlds

duplicate_control: Same source unchanged repeats are idempotent for the ledger and raw checker. Append-only deliberately counts them again. No product-of-factors ablation; all arms share the elementary likelihood.
limitations: Binary static latent-state and reliability/prior supplied; no original-world, learned or unknown-law superiority.
True correction/retraction deliberately corrupt source zero first; false correction starts with a true source zero. Conditions have different starting evidence.
Reliability one can conflict under deliberate corruption; posterior is undefined there and the explicit fallback is the supplied prior with a conflict flag.
Append-only repeats add evidence; retractions are ignored. This is a deliberately incapable comparator, not a modern revision algorithm.
Incremental log/zero counters and independent raw products are distinct; setup, update CPU and serialized payloads remain separate. One update per initialized history is measured.
Shared cases and nested histories are not independent worlds; native only, no product-of-factors ablation or confirmation.
